label: Sec.01
description: We support creative work in different ways, depending on what it sets out to do. Some ideas need room to experiment, provoke and create new cultural perspectives. Others need the time, resources and practical development to make better systems possible. We provide two pathways for both: experimental cultural projects, and practical design and experience work on open systems.
title: (Programs)
Culture
Grants
programs.detail: Direct support for independent, experimental cultural work: creative responses, public interventions, new forms of expression and projects that open up fresh perspectives on our four themes. Selected work contributes to the UNBLOCKED archive and future publications.

title: Open
Systems
programs.detail: Practical design and experience projects focused on Bitcoin as open money and open intelligence. We help you develop and prepare proposals for Spiral, which reviews applications and funds selected projects.
